PLANTATION, Fla., Sept. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation (Nasdaq: AENT), a leading distributor and fulfillment partner to the entertainment and pop-culture collectibles industry, will participate in a webcast presentation and host one-on-one meetings with investors at the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference, taking place virtually on September 29-30, 2026.


**Company Webcast**


The webcast presentation will take place at 1:15 p.m. ET on Tuesday, September 29, 2026. The webcast can be accessed by visiting the conference website at[https://lythampartners.com/fall2026/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=b23J7Zm1az2Z9kXDzVD5M7oB-9TG6JM2YvD_XCMH7_uwCBKwi82enaXusDW1EDEazd1y5XPDJnHNBtxF2z1jFNl-ddUPEf8jBMIgUJ-NdKfqvVdL5fidUPzui65TiwtBb1z5BzXkFF5tVDmFBAKGEg==) or directly at[https://app.webinar.net/vBAJY6Wd64W](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=b23J7Zm1az2Z9kXDzVD5M7DZOYjThfxlCUS2zueI9z1Rm07BmQloLWfASpE_OzvgBYFFEOK1JpqyUlYaZGjAjuo6Hh4bQqH1bXPzYoYH-MT0BkNgOMPV5v4MnyEtIMnpIvNyvTFq7J5Sptf3MYO4Eg==) . The webcast will also be available for replay following the event.


**1×1 Meetings**


Management will be participating in virtual one-on-one meetings throughout the event. To arrange a meeting with management, please contact Lytham Partners at[1×1@lythampartners.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=f4zl0f-OLyXKfGzXTpzx1Yv0nZVM1bF1BK3pxQSUFmzQs67USfq72umu4hFXg01zuNEhOQaIVrjgv_VweONOayvInfqBWg4720Nkyi11ydc=) or register for the event at[https://lythampartners.com/fall2026invreg/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=b23J7Zm1az2Z9kXDzVD5M7oB-9TG6JM2YvD_XCMH7_v0qXXNjfFjX5szxlkWwxemG84xDsTVHK7Jit7HTppNKr2hP_Mpk5WwdMBi8Qm-ktS0CvGHcevjcUdk22Id6Px3mpoEjUeTA3Q0NEqMPoa2MQ==) .


**About Alliance Entertainment**


Alliance Entertainment (NASDAQ:AENT) is a scaled entertainment commerce and collectibles platform serving content owners, brands, retailers and fans across music, movies, gaming, licensed merchandise and collectibles. The Company also owns and develops proprietary brands and platforms, including Handmade by Robots™ and Alliance Authentic™, while Endstate Authentic adds NFC-enabled authentication and digital product identity capabilities supporting provenance, brand protection and authenticated resale. Leveraging decades of industry relationships and distribution, fulfillment and inventory-management expertise, Alliance reaches more than 35,000 retail and e-commerce storefronts, connecting entertainment franchises and collectible products with consumers across channels and generations. For more information, visit[www.aent.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=wTCHxnwRvRdHSUVtF3lXzX3hA1C2jiCWOUo8J2EYiDfowHs2Bi85QmY4SqlLHDsQqvKMwC_PoxkH_Z3FqRtXgQ==) .
